O11.scope: Every invalid enum byte 3..255 is sent to both signed and unsigned mulDiv overloads; calls must fail with exactly empty returndata. Existing parser enum checks are complementary.

O37.scope: Nonexistent account, funded code-less EOA and deployed contract distinguish zero hash, keccak256(empty) and actual code hash.

O51.scope: Actual OpenZeppelin MerkleProof.processProof is the comparison oracle for a four-node proof, repeated nodes, reversed pair order and the composed foldWords root. Finite proof examples are not a cryptographic security proof.

O63.scope: Plus/negative signs, leading zeros, negative zero, empty/bare signs, invalid characters and exact positions, int256 minimum and positive overflow. Complements retained generated canonical round trips.

O64.scope: 40 deterministic full-width signed values use independently generated exact Python decimal strings, with separate explicit minimum/maximum/zero vectors in ClaimCoverageEasyTest. Plus-sign source mutation is detected.

O65.scope: Optional plus, leading/trailing point, no-digit inputs, duplicate point, exponent characters, precision 77/78 and signed scaled overflow assert exact selectors/positions. Existing three-rounding-mode tests complement grammar; viem parseUnits is deliberately not used as a grammar oracle.

O67.scope: Leading plus, exact position-zero rejection of negative zero/negative value, uint256 maximum and one-above-maximum overflow.

O68.scope: 40 independent full-width Python format vectors at precisions 0,1,2,6,18,38,77 plus explicit canonical trimming/zero/integral/error examples in ClaimCoverageEasyTest. Independent strings complement retained parse round trips.

L33.scope: Exact CallbackFailed context/reason, empty/two-word replies, noncanonical predicates, valid zero and code-less target across value predicates and word folds; fresh GasPropagationTest additionally asserts exact reserved-signal propagation and real gas-budget sweeps.

E7.scope: Malformed descriptor on unreachable node raises exact descriptor error offset 7 while an expected external-call count of zero proves admission precedes reachable-node execution.

E25.scope: Well-typed outer graph with intentionally undecodable Resolve bytes must fail with exactly empty returndata, not merely tolerate such a failure.

E38.scope: Short and invalid-offset evaluateEncoded envelopes must fail with exactly empty returndata.

E39.scope: Every invalid Kind byte 11..255 is ABI-encoded through independent uint8 mirror structs and must fail with exactly empty returndata.

C37.scope: Compiler-encoded dynamic tuple-array selection returns exact canonical string/bytes/whole-tuple values. Dirty selected narrow words and string padding raise exact offsets; a dirty skipped sibling is intentionally accepted. Complements retained finite geometry/corruption fuzz tests.

C38.scope: An invalid later tuple component is diagnosed at exact offset 16 for both empty and readable payloads, demonstrating complete descriptor parsing before data access. Complements retained descriptor mutation corpus.

C39.scope: Four nested dynamic arrays return the selected scalar and whole selected inner array byte-exactly. Runtime coverage remains finite; arbitrary finite nesting relies on conditional inductive formal correspondence and explicit arithmetic/resources premises.

C47.scope: The same valid 256-element navigation request fails with empty data at 1,000 gas and succeeds byte-exactly at 1,000,000 gas. This substantiates possible resource failure, not a portable exhaustion threshold, universal no-panic claim or complete stack/memory-failure catalogue.

W2.scope: Independent raw uint8 wire structs encode a two-entry TARGET/CALL_DATA batch accepted by pinned reference runtime and real core. Exact two calls per argument across both consumers prevent silently skipped routing. VALUE and both OutputParam fetcher layouts cross-decode and reach exact intended core refusals. No SDK-universality or output-executor storage guarantee is claimed.

O18.scope: 51 independent arbitrary-precision Python modular-power cases cover full-width signed bases/moduli, int256 minimum, exponent parity, zero, threshold neighbors, high-bit/max uint256 exponents and modulus one.

O19.scope: 90 overload-level checks use Python modular inverse/power for full-width generated operands, exponents -2,-3,-7,-31,-2^32,-2^255, exact original-magnitude noncoprime errors, minimum base, modulus one and explicit zero-modulus Panic(18).

O23.scope: 104 independently exact integer-power cases at unit scale plus three manually derived quantized step traces and exact zero/overflow/division guards. These do not independently establish arbitrary scaled per-step rounding recurrence; retain partial coverage.

O26.scope: 93 independent finite-word Horner-oracle vectors cover full int256 extremes, exact exponential guards, stratified admitted inputs and integer-truncated range-reduction neighbors. A changed quantized coefficient is detected. No global real-exponential accuracy/monotonicity/inverse bound.

O27.scope: 96 independent finite-word Horner-oracle vectors cover nonpositive exact error arguments, full int256 positive range samples and power-of-two normalization neighbors. No global real-logarithm accuracy/monotonicity/inverse bound.

O28.evidence: `contracts/tests/ClaimCoverageOracle.t.sol`; analytic accuracy guarantees are explicitly excluded
O28.scope: Documented absence of established global analytic guarantees; finite tests cannot prove absence of all theorems or supply a global error bound.

O38.scope: Forge-only injected transaction context checks three distinct versioned hashes, out-of-range/max index, and reset-to-no-blobs. Normal Node wrapper executes this fixture with isolated output/cache. Outside Hardhat Solidity discovery. Does not submit or verify real blob transactions.

O59.scope: Independent byte-by-byte first-match oracle checks lengths 1,2,31,32,33,63,64,65, successful matches with different following haystack bytes, and tail-only near misses. Scratch deletion of one tail mask is detected. No fixed gas-cost guarantee.

O60.scope: The same valid 4,097-byte concat result fails with empty data at 1,000 gas and succeeds byte-exactly at 1,000,000 gas. Existing validation/parser tests are complementary. No unlimited-size, universal no-panic or portable resource threshold assertion.

L23.scope: 21 finite input families (lengths 3,5,7,9,17,31,63; ascending/reverse/equal) check exact observed sortValues comparator counts, n*ceil(log2 n) finite bounds, and sortValues/sortWords results. Existing power-of-two counts remain. General asymptotic comparisons/moves and linear scratch-space theorem remain outside finite observations.

L44.scope: Always-positive nonreflexive comparison concretely reverses three inputs while preserving occurrences; always-equal retains first item, never-equal retains identical duplicate encodings. Normal callback errors are covered by L33. No coherent ordering/equivalence or arbitrary-history guarantee.

E40.scope: Concrete malformed graph/payload cases demonstrate declared descriptor errors and exact decoder bare reverts. Existing gas sweeps exercise graph callback exhaustion. This reconciles revised exception-aware wording, not the obsolete universal no-panic/no-exhaustion promise.

E42.scope: Compiler-AST source check establishes default-zero per-node admission loop with ++, expression.nodes[i] binding, bytes(node.valueType) shape input, cached dynamic/words destinations, admission-before-evaluation order and cached validator arguments. Three checker negative controls detect wrong descriptor, wrong cache field and decrement. Structural evidence, not a runtime total-parser-call count, no-recursive-parsing theorem or certified AST semantic proof.

O13.scope: 128 current-source independent Python arbitrary-precision sum/product signed-remainder checks cover full-width generated/boundary a,b,m. Retained 11,096 BigInt EVM checks remain prior evidence. Incomplete general bytecode equivalence does not make this behavioral testing partial.

W30.scope: Fresh byte-for-byte fixture/inlined literal and hash-field identity check, plus fresh compiled keccak hash unit test. Offline identity does not establish current public-chain code availability.

R2.scope: Configured Cancun/compiler/precompile behavior is an environment assumption; local observations cannot certify every chain.

R3.scope: CREATE2 derivation predicts an address but supplies no public-chain deployment receipt or matching-code observation. Treat as an explicit deployment limitation, not a behavioral coverage gap.

limitations: C39 arbitrary finite nesting, O23 general scaled rounding recurrence and L23 asymptotic moves/scratch memory remain partially tested.
E42 evidence is a compiler-AST structure check; it is not certified source semantics or an exact runtime count of every recursive parser invocation.
O38 uses injected Forge transaction context, not a real blob transaction.
The three Scope limitation/Environment assumption rows are documented, not promoted by synthetic tests.
A sandboxed Node run failed at file level without reporting actual case passes; the recorded outside-sandbox rerun passed both cases.
